primary_metric.name: Spearman Rank Correlation Coefficient
primary_metric.interpretation: Non-parametric measure of monotonic association between predicted and actual returns
primary_metric.sign_convention: Positive IC indicates predictions are positively correlated with actual returns

aggregation_method.description: Compute IC per calendar month, then average across months
aggregation_method.rationale: Monthly aggregation captures temporal stability while smoothing daily noise

dependence_adjustment.rationale: Account for autocorrelation in monthly IC series
